scope: Selected chronology, legal distinctions, repeated instruction, names and difficult poetry; not a full retranslation.

rows.hebrew: אַחַ֨ד עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ מֵֽ/חֹרֵ֔ב דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַר ־ שֵׂעִ֑יר עַ֖ד קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ ׃
rows.fluent: It is an eleven-day journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea by the Mount Seir route.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יְהִי֙ בְּ/אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּ/עַשְׁתֵּֽי ־ עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל ־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖/וֹ אֲלֵ/הֶֽם ׃
rows.fluent: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses told the Israelites everything the LORD had commanded him to tell them.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הַ/יָּמִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר ־ הָלַ֣כְנוּ ׀ מִ/קָּדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֗עַ עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר ־ עָבַ֨רְנוּ֙ אֶת ־ נַ֣חַל זֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה עַד ־ תֹּ֨ם כָּל ־ הַ/דּ֜וֹר אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ מִ/קֶּ֣רֶב הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לָ/הֶֽם ׃
rows.fluent: Thirty-eight years passed between our departure from Kadesh-barnea and our crossing of the Wadi Zered. By then that entire generation of fighting men had died out from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.

rows.hebrew: כִּ֣י רַק ־ ע֞וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֗ן נִשְׁאַר֮ מִ/יֶּ֣תֶר הָ/רְפָאִים֒ הִנֵּ֤ה עַרְשׂ/וֹ֙ עֶ֣רֶשׂ בַּרְזֶ֔ל הֲ/לֹ֣ה הִ֔וא בְּ/רַבַּ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן תֵּ֧שַׁע אַמּ֣וֹת אָרְכָּ֗/הּ וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע אַמּ֛וֹת רָחְבָּ֖/הּ בְּ/אַמַּת ־ אִֽישׁ ׃
rows.fluent: Only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. His bed was made of iron—is it not in Rabbah of the Ammonites? It was nine cubits long and four cubits wide, measured by the ordinary human cubit.

rows.hebrew: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר הַ/גִּלְעָ֤ד וְ/כָל ־ הַ/בָּשָׁן֙ מַמְלֶ֣כֶת ע֔וֹג נָתַ֕תִּי לַ/חֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כֹּ֣ל חֶ֤בֶל הָֽ/אַרְגֹּב֙ לְ/כָל ־ הַ/בָּשָׁ֔ן הַ/ה֥וּא יִקָּרֵ֖א אֶ֥רֶץ רְפָאִֽים ׃
rows.fluent: I gave the rest of Gilead and all Bashan, Og's kingdom, to the half-tribe of Manasseh. The whole region of Argob, all that part of Bashan, is called the land of Rephaim.

rows.hebrew: וָ/אֲצַ֣ו אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִ֖וא לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֗ם נָתַ֨ן לָ/כֶ֜ם אֶת ־ הָ/אָ֤רֶץ הַ/זֹּאת֙ לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֔/הּ חֲלוּצִ֣ים תַּֽעַבְר֗וּ לִ/פְנֵ֛י אֲחֵי/כֶ֥ם בְּנֵֽי ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל ־ בְּנֵי ־ חָֽיִל ׃
rows.fluent: At that time I commanded you, ‘The LORD your God has given you this land to possess. All your fighting men must cross over armed ahead of your brothers, the Israelites.

rows.hebrew: לֹ֖א תְִּירָא֑וּ/ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם ה֖וּא הַ/נִּלְחָ֥ם לָ/כֶֽם ׃ ס

rows.fluent: Do not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God is the one who fights for you.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּתְעַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה בִּ/י֙ לְמַ֣עַנְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלַ/י֙ רַב ־ לָ֔/ךְ אַל ־ תּ֗וֹסֶף דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛/י ע֖וֹד בַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה ׃
rows.fluent: But the LORD was furious with me because of you and would not listen to me. He said, ‘Enough! Do not speak to me about this again.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אַתֶּם֙ הַ/דְּבֵקִ֔ים בַּ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם חַיִּ֥ים כֻּלְּ/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּֽוֹם ׃
rows.fluent: But all of you who cling to the LORD your God are alive today.

rows.hebrew: וְ/נִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְ/נַפְשֹׁתֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֤א רְאִיתֶם֙ כָּל ־ תְּמוּנָ֔ה בְּ/י֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם בְּ/חֹרֵ֖ב מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הָ/אֵֽשׁ ׃
rows.fluent: So watch yourselves closely. You saw no form on the day the LORD spoke to you at Horeb from the fire.

rows.hebrew: וּ/פֶן ־ תִּשָּׂ֨א עֵינֶ֜י/ךָ הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יְמָ/ה וְֽ֠/רָאִיתָ אֶת ־ הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ וְ/אֶת ־ הַ/יָּרֵ֜חַ וְ/אֶת ־ הַ/כּֽוֹכָבִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/נִדַּחְתָּ֛ וְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥יתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם וַ/עֲבַדְתָּ֑/ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָלַ֜ק יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֹתָ֔/ם לְ/כֹל֙ הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל ־ הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם ׃
rows.fluent: When you look up to the heavens and see the sun, moon, and stars, all the host of heaven, do not be drawn away to bow down to them and serve them. The LORD your God has allotted them to all the peoples everywhere under heaven.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אֶתְ/כֶם֙ לָקַ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יּוֹצִ֥א אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם מִ/כּ֥וּר הַ/בַּרְזֶ֖ל מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם לִ/הְי֥וֹת ל֛/וֹ לְ/עַ֥ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה ׃
rows.fluent: But the LORD took you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of his own inheritance, as you are today.

rows.hebrew: לָ/נֻ֨ס שָׁ֜מָּ/ה רוֹצֵ֗חַ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְצַ֤ח אֶת ־ רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ בִּ/בְלִי ־ דַ֔עַת וְ/ה֛וּא לֹא ־ שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖/וֹ מִ/תְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשׁ֑וֹם וְ/נָ֗ס אֶל ־ אַחַ֛ת מִן ־ הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖ל וָ/חָֽי ׃
rows.fluent: where someone could flee after killing a neighbor unintentionally, without having hated that neighbor beforehand. By fleeing to one of these towns, the killer could stay alive.

rows.hebrew: פָּנִ֣ים ׀ בְּ/פָנִ֗ים דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה עִמָּ/כֶ֛ם בָּ/הָ֖ר מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הָ/אֵֽשׁ ׃
rows.fluent: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain, from the fire.

rows.hebrew: שָׁמ֛וֹר אֶת ־ י֥וֹם הַ/שַׁבָּ֖ת לְ/קַדְּשׁ֑/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ ׃

rows.fluent: Observe the Sabbath day and keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.

rows.hebrew: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּֽעֲבֹ֔ד וְ/עָשִׂ֖יתָ כָּל ־ מְלַאכְתֶּֽ/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: For six days you are to labor and do all your work,

rows.hebrew: וְ/י֨וֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י שַׁבָּ֖ת לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לֹ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כָל ־ מְלָאכָ֡ה אַתָּ֣ה וּ/בִנְ/ךָֽ ־ וּ/בִתֶּ֣/ךָ וְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָֽ ־ וַ֠/אֲמָתֶ/ךָ וְ/שׁוֹרְ/ךָ֨ וַ/חֲמֹֽרְ/ךָ֜ וְ/כָל ־ בְּהֶמְתֶּ֗/ךָ וְ/גֵֽרְ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ לְמַ֗עַן יָנ֛וּחַ עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ וַ/אֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ כָּמֽוֹ/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You must not do any work—you, your son or daughter, your male or female slave, your ox or donkey or any of your livestock, or the resident foreigner within your gates—so that your male and female slaves may rest as you do.

rows.hebrew: וְ/זָכַרְתָּ֗ כִּ֣י ־ עֶ֤בֶד הָיִ֨יתָ֙ ׀ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יֹּצִ֨אֲ/ךָ֜ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם בְּ/יָ֥ד חֲזָקָ֖ה וּ/בִ/זְרֹ֣עַ נְטוּיָ֑ה עַל ־ כֵּ֗ן צִוְּ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת ־ י֥וֹם הַ/שַׁבָּֽת ׃ ס

rows.fluent: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt and that the LORD your God brought you out with a strong hand and an outstretched arm. That is why the LORD your God commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ד אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֶ֑/ךָ ס וְ/לֹ֨א תִתְאַוֶּ֜ה בֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֗/ךָ שָׂדֵ֜/הוּ וְ/עַבְדּ֤/וֹ וַ/אֲמָת/וֹ֙ שׁוֹר֣/וֹ וַ/חֲמֹר֔/וֹ וְ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/רֵעֶֽ/ךָ ׃ ס
rows.fluent: You must not covet your neighbor's wife. You must not desire your neighbor's house or field, male or female slave, ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.’

rows.hebrew: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ יְהוָ֥ה ׀ אֶחָֽד ׃

<note n="5">Large letter(s). Shown as large letters without a superscript note number. </note>
rows.fluent: Hear, Israel: the LORD our God, the LORD is one.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָי֞וּ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֛ הַ/יּ֖וֹם עַל ־ לְבָבֶֽ/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: These words that I command you today must be on your heart.
Teach them to your children again and again. Talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

rows.hebrew: וּ/קְשַׁרְתָּ֥/ם לְ/א֖וֹת עַל ־ יָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/טֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽי/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: Bind them as a sign on your hand, and let them be bands between your eyes.

rows.hebrew: וּ/כְתַבְתָּ֛/ם עַל ־ מְזוּזֹ֥ת בֵּיתֶ֖/ךָ וּ/בִ/שְׁעָרֶֽי/ךָ ׃ ס
rows.fluent: Write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.

rows.hebrew: וַֽ/יְעַנְּ/ךָ֮ וַ/יַּרְעִבֶ/ךָ֒ וַ/יַּֽאֲכִֽלְ/ךָ֤ אֶת הַ/מָּן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא ־ יָדַ֔עְתָּ וְ/לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ/ן אֲבֹתֶ֑י/ךָ לְמַ֣עַן הוֹדִֽעֲ/ךָ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל ־ הַ/לֶּ֤חֶם לְ/בַדּ/וֹ֙ יִחְיֶ֣ה הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם כִּ֛י עַל ־ כָּל ־ מוֹצָ֥א פִֽי ־ יְהוָ֖ה יִחְיֶ֥ה הָ/אָדָֽם ׃

rows.fluent: He humbled you, let you go hungry, and fed you manna, which neither you nor your fathers had known. He did this to teach you that a human being does not live on bread alone, but on everything that comes from the LORD's mouth.

rows.hebrew: שִׂמְלָ֨תְ/ךָ֜ לֹ֤א בָֽלְתָה֙ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/רַגְלְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א בָצֵ֑קָה זֶ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה ׃
rows.fluent: Your clothing did not wear out on you, and your feet did not swell during these forty years.

rows.hebrew: וָ/אַ֤עַשׂ אֲרוֹן֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וָ/אֶפְסֹ֛ל שְׁנֵי ־ לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּ/רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וָ/אַ֣עַל הָ/הָ֔רָ/ה וּ/שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/לֻּחֹ֖ת בְּ/יָדִֽ/י ׃
rows.fluent: So I made an ark of acacia wood, cut two stone tablets like the first ones, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֨ב עַֽל ־ הַ/לֻּחֹ֜ת כַּ/מִּכְתָּ֣ב הָ/רִאשׁ֗וֹן אֵ֚ת עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֲלֵי/כֶ֥ם בָּ/הָ֛ר מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הָ/אֵ֖שׁ בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/קָּהָ֑ל וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֥/ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָֽ/י ׃
rows.fluent: The LORD wrote on the tablets what he had written before: the Ten Words he spoke to you on the mountain from the fire, on the day of the assembly. Then he gave them to me.

rows.hebrew: וָ/אֵ֗פֶן וָֽ/אֵרֵד֙ מִן ־ הָ/הָ֔ר וָֽ/אָשִׂם֙ אֶת ־ הַ/לֻּחֹ֔ת בָּ/אָר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַ/יִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖/נִי יְהוָֽה ׃
rows.fluent: I turned and came down the mountain and put the tablets in the ark I had made. They are still there, as the LORD commanded me.

rows.hebrew: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָֽסְע֛וּ מִ/בְּאֵרֹ֥ת בְּנֵי ־ יַעֲקָ֖ן מוֹסֵרָ֑ה שָׁ֣ם מֵ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֣ר שָׁ֔ם וַ/יְכַהֵ֛ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו ׃
rows.fluent: The Israelites traveled from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah. Aaron died and was buried there, and his son Eleazar served as priest in his place.

rows.hebrew: וְ/נָתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר ־ אַרְצְ/כֶ֛ם בְּ/עִתּ֖/וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּ/מַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְ/אָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔/ךָ וְ/תִֽירֹשְׁ/ךָ֖ וְ/יִצְהָרֶֽ/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: I will give rain for your land in its season, the autumn rain and the spring rain, so that you may gather your grain, new wine, and oil.
I will provide grass in your fields for your livestock, and you will eat your fill.’

rows.hebrew: וְ/שַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת ־ דְּבָרַ֣/י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל ־ לְבַבְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/עַֽל ־ נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֑ם וּ/קְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤/ם לְ/אוֹת֙ עַל ־ יֶדְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/טוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵי/כֶֽם ׃
rows.fluent: Place these words of mine on your heart and soul. Bind them as a sign on your hand, and let them be bands between your eyes.
Teach them to your children. Speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

rows.hebrew: וּ/כְתַבְתָּ֛/ם עַל ־ מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖/ךָ וּ/בִ/שְׁעָרֶֽי/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: Write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,

rows.hebrew: לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵי/כֶם֙ וִ/ימֵ֣י בְנֵי/כֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַ/אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם לָ/תֵ֣ת לָ/הֶ֑ם כִּ/ימֵ֥י הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל ־ הָ/אָֽרֶץ ׃ ס
rows.fluent: so that your days and your children's days in the land the LORD swore to your fathers to give them may be many, as long as the heavens are over the earth.

rows.hebrew: כִּ֠י אִֽם ־ אֶל ־ הַ/מָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר ־ יִבְחַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֙ מִ/כָּל ־ שִׁבְטֵי/כֶ֔ם לָ/שׂ֥וּם אֶת ־ שְׁמ֖/וֹ שָׁ֑ם לְ/שִׁכְנ֥/וֹ תִדְרְשׁ֖וּ וּ/בָ֥אתָ שָֽׁמָּ/ה ׃
rows.fluent: Instead, seek the place the LORD your God will choose from all your tribes to put his name there. Go to his dwelling place.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָיָ֣ה הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר ־ יִבְחַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֥ם בּ/וֹ֙ לְ/שַׁכֵּ֤ן שְׁמ/וֹ֙ שָׁ֔ם שָׁ֣מָּ/ה תָבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֛ת כָּל ־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם עוֹלֹתֵי/כֶ֣ם וְ/זִבְחֵי/כֶ֗ם מַעְשְׂרֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ וּ/תְרֻמַ֣ת יֶדְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/כֹל֙ מִבְחַ֣ר נִדְרֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּדְּר֖וּ לַֽ/יהוָֽה ׃
rows.fluent: Then bring everything I command you to the place the LORD your God will choose for his name to dwell: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and the contributions of your hands, and all the choice offerings you vow to the LORD.

rows.hebrew: רַק֩ בְּ/כָל ־ אַוַּ֨ת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֜ תִּזְבַּ֣ח ׀ וְ/אָכַלְתָּ֣ בָשָׂ֗ר כְּ/בִרְכַּ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן ־ לְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/כָל ־ שְׁעָרֶ֑י/ךָ הַ/טָּמֵ֤א וְ/הַ/טָּהוֹר֙ יֹאכְלֶ֔/נּוּ כַּ/צְּבִ֖י וְ/כָ/אַיָּֽל ׃
rows.fluent: You may, however, slaughter animals and eat meat in any of your towns whenever you desire, according to the blessing the LORD your God has given you. Both the unclean and the clean may eat it, as they would gazelle or deer.

rows.hebrew: רַ֥ק הַ/דָּ֖ם לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ עַל ־ הָ/אָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖/נּוּ כַּ/מָּֽיִם ׃
rows.fluent: But you must not eat the blood. Pour it on the ground like water.

rows.hebrew: כִּֽי ־ יִרְחַ֨ק מִמְּ/ךָ֜ הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִבְחַ֜ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶי/ךָ֮ לָ/שׂ֣וּם שְׁמ֣/וֹ שָׁם֒ וְ/זָבַחְתָּ֞ מִ/בְּקָרְ/ךָ֣ וּ/מִ/צֹּֽאנְ/ךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְ/ךָ֔ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִ֑/ךָ וְ/אָֽכַלְתָּ֙ בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כֹ֖ל אַוַּ֥ת נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: If the place the LORD your God chooses to put his name is too far from you, you may slaughter from the herds and flocks the LORD has given you, as I commanded you, and eat in your towns whenever you desire.

rows.hebrew: רַ֣ק חֲזַ֗ק לְ/בִלְתִּי֙ אֲכֹ֣ל הַ/דָּ֔ם כִּ֥י הַ/דָּ֖ם ה֣וּא הַ/נָּ֑פֶשׁ וְ/לֹא ־ תֹאכַ֥ל הַ/נֶּ֖פֶשׁ עִם ־ הַ/בָּשָֽׂר ׃
rows.fluent: But be firm about not eating the blood, because the blood is the life. You must not eat the life with the flesh.

rows.hebrew: אֵ֣ת כָּל ־ הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֹת֥/וֹ תִשְׁמְר֖וּ לַ/עֲשׂ֑וֹת לֹא ־ תֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א תִגְרַ֖ע מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ ׃ פ
rows.fluent: Be careful to practice everything I command you. Do not add to it or take anything away from it.”

rows.hebrew: לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֣וּ כָל ־ נְ֠בֵלָה לַ/גֵּ֨ר אֲשֶׁר ־ בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֜י/ךָ תִּתְּנֶ֣נָּ/ה וַ/אֲכָלָ֗/הּ א֤וֹ מָכֹר֙ לְ/נָכְרִ֔י כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לֹֽא ־ תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּ/חֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽ/וֹ ׃ פ
rows.fluent: Do not eat an animal found dead. You may give it to the resident foreigner in your town to eat, or sell it to a foreigner. For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. Do not boil a young goat in its mother's milk.

rows.hebrew: מִ/קְצֵ֣ה ׀ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים תּוֹצִיא֙ אֶת ־ כָּל ־ מַעְשַׂר֙ תְּבוּאָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ בַּ/שָּׁנָ֖ה הַ/הִ֑וא וְ/הִנַּחְתָּ֖ בִּ/שְׁעָרֶֽי/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: At the end of every three years, bring out the whole tithe of that year's produce and store it in your towns.

rows.hebrew: וּ/בָ֣א הַ/לֵּוִ֡י כִּ֣י אֵֽין ־ ל/וֹ֩ חֵ֨לֶק וְ/נַחֲלָ֜ה עִמָּ֗/ךְ וְ֠/הַ/גֵּר וְ/הַ/יָּת֤וֹם וְ/הָֽ/אַלְמָנָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אָכְל֖וּ וְ/שָׂבֵ֑עוּ לְמַ֤עַן יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כָל ־ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶֽׂה ׃ ס
rows.fluent: Then the Levite, who has no share or inheritance with you, and the resident foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow in your towns can come and eat their fill. Then the LORD your God will bless you in all the work of your hands.”

rows.hebrew: מִ/קֵּ֥ץ שֶֽׁבַע ־ שָׁנִ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה שְׁמִטָּֽה ׃
rows.fluent: “At the end of every seven years, grant a release of debts.

rows.hebrew: וְ/זֶה֮ דְּבַ֣ר הַ/שְּׁמִטָּה֒ שָׁמ֗וֹט כָּל ־ בַּ֨עַל֙ מַשֵּׁ֣ה יָד֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַשֶּׁ֖ה בְּ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ לֹֽא ־ יִגֹּ֤שׂ אֶת ־ רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ וְ/אֶת ־ אָחִ֔י/ו כִּֽי ־ קָרָ֥א שְׁמִטָּ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה ׃
rows.fluent: This is how the release works: every creditor must release the claim on what they have lent their neighbor. They must not press their neighbor, their fellow Israelite, for payment, because the LORD's release has been proclaimed.

rows.hebrew: אֶת ־ הַ/נָּכְרִ֖י תִּגֹּ֑שׂ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/ךָ֛ אֶת ־ אָחִ֖י/ךָ תַּשְׁמֵ֥ט יָדֶֽ/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: You may demand payment from a foreigner, but you must release your claim on whatever your fellow Israelite owes you.

rows.hebrew: אֶ֕פֶס כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה ־ בְּ/ךָ֖ אֶבְי֑וֹן כִּֽי ־ בָרֵ֤ךְ יְבָֽרֶכְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה בָּ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ נֹֽתֵן ־ לְ/ךָ֥ נַחֲלָ֖ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ ׃
rows.fluent: Yet there should be no poor among you, for the LORD will surely bless you in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess as an inheritance,

rows.hebrew: רַ֚ק אִם ־ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַ֔ע בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לִ/שְׁמֹ֤ר לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת ־ כָּל ־ הַ/מִּצְוָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּֽוֹם ׃
rows.fluent: if only you listen carefully to the LORD your God and take care to carry out every command I give you today.

rows.hebrew: כִּ֛י לֹא ־ יֶחְדַּ֥ל אֶבְי֖וֹן מִ/קֶּ֣רֶב הָ/אָ֑רֶץ עַל ־ כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר פָּ֠תֹחַ תִּפְתַּ֨ח אֶת ־ יָדְ/ךָ֜ לְ/אָחִ֧י/ךָ לַ/עֲנִיֶּ֛/ךָ וּ/לְ/אֶבְיֹנְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/אַרְצֶֽ/ךָ ׃ ס
rows.fluent: There will always be poor people in the land. That is why I command you to open your hand wide to your fellow Israelite, to the poor and needy in your land.
If one of your people, a Hebrew man or woman, is sold to you and serves you for six years, you must set that person free in the seventh year.
When you set them free, do not send them away empty-handed.

rows.hebrew: הַעֲנֵ֤יק תַּעֲנִיק֙ ל֔/וֹ מִ/צֹּ֣אנְ/ךָ֔ וּ/מִֽ/גָּרְנְ/ךָ֖ וּ/מִ/יִּקְבֶ֑/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר בֵּרַכְ/ךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ תִּתֶּן ־ לֽ/וֹ ׃
rows.fluent: Supply them generously from your flock, your threshing floor, and your winepress. Give to them from the blessing the LORD your God has given you.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָיָה֙ כִּֽי ־ יֹאמַ֣ר אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ לֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א מֵ/עִמָּ֑/ךְ כִּ֤י אֲהֵֽבְ/ךָ֙ וְ/אֶת ־ בֵּיתֶ֔/ךָ כִּי ־ ט֥וֹב ל֖/וֹ עִמָּֽ/ךְ ׃
rows.fluent: But suppose he says to you, ‘I will not leave you,’ because he loves you and your household and is well off with you.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת ־ הַ/מַּרְצֵ֗עַ וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה בְ/אָזְנ/וֹ֙ וּ/בַ/דֶּ֔לֶת וְ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ עֶ֣בֶד עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/אַ֥ף לַ/אֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ תַּעֲשֶׂה ־ כֵּֽן ׃
rows.fluent: Then take an awl and drive it through his ear into the door. He will be your slave permanently. Do the same for your female slave.

rows.hebrew: לֹא ־ יִקְשֶׁ֣ה בְ/עֵינֶ֗/ךָ בְּ/שַׁלֵּֽחֲ/ךָ֙ אֹת֤/וֹ חָפְשִׁי֙ מֵֽ/עִמָּ֔/ךְ כִּ֗י מִשְׁנֶה֙ שְׂכַ֣ר שָׂכִ֔יר עֲבָֽדְ/ךָ֖ שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וּ/בֵֽרַכְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶֽׂה ׃ פ
rows.fluent: Do not resent setting your slave free. Those six years of service have been worth twice the wages of a hired worker. The LORD your God will bless you in everything you do.

rows.hebrew: וְ/שָׂמַחְתָּ֞ לִ/פְנֵ֣י ׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ אַתָּ֨ה וּ/בִנְ/ךָ֣ וּ/בִתֶּ/ךָ֮ וְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ וַ/אֲמָתֶ/ךָ֒ וְ/הַ/לֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הַ/גֵּ֛ר וְ/הַ/יָּת֥וֹם וְ/הָ/אַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/קִרְבֶּ֑/ךָ בַּ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/שַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖/וֹ שָֽׁם ׃
rows.fluent: Rejoice before the LORD your God at the place he chooses for his name to dwell—you, your son and daughter, your male and female slave, the Levite in your towns, and the resident foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow among you.
Rejoice at your festival—you, your son and daughter, your male and female slave, the Levite, the resident foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow in your towns.

rows.hebrew: עַל ־ פִּ֣י ׀ שְׁנַ֣יִם עֵדִ֗ים א֛וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עֵדִ֖ים יוּמַ֣ת הַ/מֵּ֑ת לֹ֣א יוּמַ֔ת עַל ־ פִּ֖י עֵ֥ד אֶחָֽד ׃
rows.fluent: A person may be put to death only on the testimony of two or three witnesses. No one may be put to death on the testimony of just one witness.

rows.hebrew: יַ֣ד הָ/עֵדִ֞ים תִּֽהְיֶה ־ בּ֤/וֹ בָ/רִאשֹׁנָה֙ לַ/הֲמִית֔/וֹ וְ/יַ֥ד כָּל ־ הָ/עָ֖ם בָּ/אַחֲרֹנָ֑ה וּ/בִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָ/רָ֖ע מִ/קִּרְבֶּֽ/ךָ ׃ פ
rows.fluent: The witnesses' hands must be the first raised to put the person to death, followed by the hands of all the people. You must purge the evil from among you.

rows.hebrew: רַק֮ לֹא ־ יַרְבֶּה ־ לּ֣/וֹ סוּסִים֒ וְ/לֹֽא ־ יָשִׁ֤יב אֶת ־ הָ/עָם֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָ/ה לְמַ֖עַן הַרְבּ֣וֹת ס֑וּס וַֽ/יהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר לָ/כֶ֔ם לֹ֣א תֹסִפ֗וּ/ן לָ/שׁ֛וּב בַּ/דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/זֶּ֖ה עֽוֹד ׃
rows.fluent: He must not accumulate horses for himself or send the people back to Egypt to obtain more horses. The LORD has told you, ‘You must never go back that way again.’

rows.hebrew: וְ/לֹ֤א יַרְבֶּה ־ לּ/וֹ֙ נָשִׁ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א יָס֖וּר לְבָב֑/וֹ וְ/כֶ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֔ב לֹ֥א יַרְבֶּה ־ לּ֖/וֹ מְאֹֽד ׃
rows.fluent: He must not take many wives, lest his heart turn away. Nor may he accumulate great amounts of silver and gold for himself.

rows.hebrew: לְ/בִלְתִּ֤י רוּם ־ לְבָב/וֹ֙ מֵֽ/אֶחָ֔י/ו וּ/לְ/בִלְתִּ֛י ס֥וּר מִן ־ הַ/מִּצְוָ֖ה יָמִ֣ין וּ/שְׂמֹ֑אול לְמַעַן֩ יַאֲרִ֨יךְ יָמִ֧ים עַל ־ מַמְלַכְתּ֛/וֹ ה֥וּא וּ/בָנָ֖י/ו בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵֽל ׃ ס
rows.fluent: Then his heart will not rise above his fellow Israelites, and he will not turn from the command to the right or to the left. In this way he and his sons may reign long in Israel.”

rows.hebrew: נָבִ֨יא מִ/קִּרְבְּ/ךָ֤ מֵ/אַחֶ֨י/ךָ֙ כָּמֹ֔/נִי יָקִ֥ים לְ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ אֵלָ֖י/ו תִּשְׁמָעֽוּ/ן ׃
rows.fluent: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among you, from your fellow Israelites. You must listen to him.

rows.hebrew: נָבִ֨יא אָקִ֥ים לָ/הֶ֛ם מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּמ֑וֹ/ךָ וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י דְבָרַ/י֙ בְּ/פִ֔י/ו וְ/דִבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל ־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוֶּֽ/נּוּ ׃
rows.fluent: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their fellow Israelites. I will put my words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.

rows.hebrew: וְ/זֶה֙ דְּבַ֣ר הָ/רֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר ־ יָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּ/ה וָ/חָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַכֶּ֤ה אֶת ־ רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ בִּ/בְלִי ־ דַ֔עַת וְ/ה֛וּא לֹא ־ שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖/וֹ מִ/תְּמֹ֥ל שִׁלְשֹֽׁם ׃
rows.fluent: This is the case of someone who may flee there and live: a person who kills a neighbor unintentionally, without having hated that neighbor before.

rows.hebrew: וַ/אֲשֶׁר֩ יָבֹ֨א אֶת ־ רֵעֵ֥/הוּ בַ/יַּעַר֮ לַ/חְטֹ֣ב עֵצִים֒ וְ/נִדְּחָ֨ה יָד֤/וֹ בַ/גַּרְזֶן֙ לִ/כְרֹ֣ת הָ/עֵ֔ץ וְ/נָשַׁ֤ל הַ/בַּרְזֶל֙ מִן ־ הָ/עֵ֔ץ וּ/מָצָ֥א אֶת ־ רֵעֵ֖/הוּ וָ/מֵ֑ת ה֗וּא יָנ֛וּס אֶל ־ אַחַ֥ת הֶ/עָרִים ־ הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וָ/חָֽי ׃
rows.fluent: For example, a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood. As he swings his axe to cut a tree, the iron head slips from the handle, strikes his neighbor, and kills him. The man may flee to one of these towns and live.

rows.hebrew: פֶּן ־ יִרְדֹּף֩ גֹּאֵ֨ל הַ/דָּ֜ם אַחֲרֵ֣י הָ/רֹצֵ֗חַ כִּי ־ יֵחַם֮ לְבָב/וֹ֒ וְ/הִשִּׂיג֛/וֹ כִּֽי ־ יִרְבֶּ֥ה הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ וְ/הִכָּ֣ה/וּ נָ֑פֶשׁ וְ/ל/וֹ֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁפַּט ־ מָ֔וֶת כִּ֠י לֹ֣א שֹׂנֵ֥א ה֛וּא ל֖/וֹ מִ/תְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם ׃
rows.fluent: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the killer in the heat of anger, overtake him because the journey is long, and kill him. Yet he does not deserve death, because he had not hated his neighbor before.

rows.hebrew: וְ/כִֽי ־ יִהְיֶ֥ה אִישׁ֙ שֹׂנֵ֣א לְ/רֵעֵ֔/הוּ וְ/אָ֤רַב ל/וֹ֙ וְ/קָ֣ם עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/הִכָּ֥ה/וּ נֶ֖פֶשׁ וָ/מֵ֑ת וְ/נָ֕ס אֶל ־ אַחַ֖ת הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽל ׃
rows.fluent: But suppose a man hates his neighbor, lies in wait, attacks and kills him, and then flees to one of these towns.

rows.hebrew: וְ/שָֽׁלְחוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י עִיר֔/וֹ וְ/לָקְח֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ מִ/שָּׁ֑ם וְ/נָתְנ֣וּ אֹת֗/וֹ בְּ/יַ֛ד גֹּאֵ֥ל הַ/דָּ֖ם וָ/מֵֽת ׃
rows.fluent: The elders of his own town must send for him, bring him back, and hand him over to the avenger of blood to be put to death.

rows.hebrew: לֹא ־ תָח֥וֹס עֵֽינְ/ךָ֖ עָלָ֑י/ו וּ/בִֽעַרְתָּ֧ דַֽם ־ הַ/נָּקִ֛י מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/ט֥וֹב לָֽ/ךְ ׃ ס
rows.fluent: Do not let your eye pity him. Purge the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, so that it may go well with you.

rows.hebrew: לֹֽא ־ יָקוּם֩ עֵ֨ד אֶחָ֜ד בְּ/אִ֗ישׁ לְ/כָל ־ עָוֺן֙ וּ/לְ/כָל ־ חַטָּ֔את בְּ/כָל ־ חֵ֖טְא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶֽחֱטָ֑א עַל ־ פִּ֣י ׀ שְׁנֵ֣י עֵדִ֗ים א֛וֹ עַל ־ פִּ֥י שְׁלֹשָֽׁה ־ עֵדִ֖ים יָק֥וּם דָּבָֽר ׃
rows.fluent: One witness alone cannot establish a charge against someone for any wrongdoing or sin, whatever the offense. A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.

rows.hebrew: כִּֽי ־ תִקְרַ֣ב אֶל ־ עִ֔יר לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם עָלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/קָרָ֥אתָ אֵלֶ֖י/הָ לְ/שָׁלֽוֹם ׃
rows.fluent: When you approach a town to fight against it, first offer it terms of peace.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָיָה֙ אִם ־ שָׁל֣וֹם תַּֽעַנְ/ךָ֔ וּ/פָתְחָ֖ה לָ֑/ךְ וְ/הָיָ֞ה כָּל ־ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/נִּמְצָא ־ בָ֗/הּ יִהְי֥וּ לְ/ךָ֛ לָ/מַ֖ס וַ/עֲבָדֽוּ/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: If it accepts peace and opens its gates to you, all the people found there are to perform forced labor and serve you.

rows.hebrew: וְ/אִם ־ לֹ֤א תַשְׁלִים֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ וְ/עָשְׂתָ֥ה עִמְּ/ךָ֖ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ/צַרְתָּ֖ עָלֶֽי/הָּ ׃

<note n="p">We read punctuation in L differently from BHS. </note>
rows.fluent: If it refuses peace and makes war against you, lay siege to it.

rows.hebrew: וּ/נְתָנָ֛/הּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הִכִּיתָ֥ אֶת ־ כָּל ־ זְכוּרָ֖/הּ לְ/פִי ־ חָֽרֶב ׃
rows.fluent: When the LORD your God hands it over to you, strike down all its males with the sword.

rows.hebrew: רַ֣ק הַ֠/נָּשִׁים וְ/הַ/טַּ֨ף וְ/הַ/בְּהֵמָ֜ה וְ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בָ/עִ֛יר כָּל ־ שְׁלָלָ֖/הּ תָּבֹ֣ז לָ֑/ךְ וְ/אָֽכַלְתָּ֙ אֶת ־ שְׁלַ֣ל אֹיְבֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לָֽ/ךְ ׃
rows.fluent: But take the women, children, livestock, and everything else in the town as plunder for yourselves. You may live on the plunder of the enemies the LORD your God has given you.

rows.hebrew: כֵּ֤ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ לְ/כָל ־ הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים הָ/רְחֹקֹ֥ת מִמְּ/ךָ֖ מְאֹ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא ־ מֵ/עָרֵ֥י הַ/גּֽוֹיִם ־ הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה הֵֽנָּה ׃
rows.fluent: This is how you are to treat all the towns far away from you, those that do not belong to these nations here.

rows.hebrew: רַ֗ק מֵ/עָרֵ֤י הָֽ/עַמִּים֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ נַחֲלָ֑ה לֹ֥א תְחַיֶּ֖ה כָּל ־ נְשָׁמָֽה ׃
rows.fluent: But in the towns of these peoples that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, leave alive nothing that breathes.

rows.hebrew: כִּֽי ־ הַחֲרֵ֣ם תַּחֲרִימֵ֗/ם הַ/חִתִּ֤י וְ/הָ/אֱמֹרִי֙ הַ/כְּנַעֲנִ֣י וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֔י הַ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֑י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: Devote them completely to destruction—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—as the LORD your God commanded you.

rows.hebrew: לְמַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא ־ יְלַמְּד֤וּ אֶתְ/כֶם֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּ/כֹל֙ תּֽוֹעֲבֹתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ לֵֽ/אלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם ׃ ס
rows.fluent: Then they will not teach you to do all the detestable things they do for their gods, causing you to sin against the LORD your God.

rows.hebrew: כִּֽי ־ תֵצֵ֥א לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה עַל ־ אֹיְבֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/נְתָנ֞/וֹ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ בְּ/יָדֶ֖/ךָ וְ/שָׁבִ֥יתָ שִׁבְיֽ/וֹ ׃
rows.fluent: When you go to war against your enemies, the LORD your God hands them over to you, and you take captives,
if you see a beautiful woman among the captives, desire her, and would take her as your wife,

rows.hebrew: וַ/הֲבֵאתָ֖/הּ אֶל ־ תּ֣וֹךְ בֵּיתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/גִלְּחָה֙ אֶת ־ רֹאשָׁ֔/הּ וְ/עָשְׂתָ֖ה אֶת ־ צִפָּרְנֶֽי/הָ ׃
rows.fluent: bring her into your house. She is to shave her head and trim her nails.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הֵסִ֩ירָה֩ אֶת ־ שִׂמְלַ֨ת שִׁבְיָ֜/הּ מֵ/עָלֶ֗י/הָ וְ/יָֽשְׁבָה֙ בְּ/בֵיתֶ֔/ךָ וּ/בָֽכְתָ֛ה אֶת ־ אָבִ֥י/הָ וְ/אֶת ־ אִמָּ֖/הּ יֶ֣רַח יָמִ֑ים וְ/אַ֨חַר כֵּ֜ן תָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ וּ/בְעַלְתָּ֔/הּ וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה ׃
rows.fluent: She must remove the clothes she wore as a captive and stay in your house, mourning her father and mother for a full month. After that you may have sex with her and become her husband, and she will be your wife.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָיָ֞ה אִם ־ לֹ֧א חָפַ֣צְתָּ בָּ֗/הּ וְ/שִׁלַּחְתָּ/הּ֙ לְ/נַפְשָׁ֔/הּ וּ/מָכֹ֥ר לֹא ־ תִמְכְּרֶ֖/נָּה בַּ/כָּ֑סֶף לֹא ־ תִתְעַמֵּ֣ר בָּ֔/הּ תַּ֖חַת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִנִּיתָֽ/הּ ׃ ס
rows.fluent: If you no longer want her, let her go free. You must not sell her for silver or treat her as a slave, because you have humiliated her.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הוֹצֵאתֶ֨ם אֶת ־ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֜ם אֶל ־ שַׁ֣עַר ׀ הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/הִ֗וא וּ/סְקַלְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֥/ם בָּ/אֲבָנִים֮ וָ/מֵתוּ֒ אֶת ־ ה/נער עַל ־ דְּבַר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא ־ צָעֲקָ֣ה בָ/עִ֔יר וְ/אֶ֨ת ־ הָ/אִ֔ישׁ עַל ־ דְּבַ֥ר אֲשֶׁר ־ עִנָּ֖ה אֶת ־ אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וּ/בִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָ/רָ֖ע מִ/קִּרְבֶּֽ/ךָ ׃ ס
rows.fluent: bring both of them to the gate of that town and stone them to death: the young woman because she did not cry out in the town, and the man because he violated his neighbor's wife. You must purge the evil from among you.

rows.hebrew: וְֽ/אִם ־ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֞ה יִמְצָ֣א הָ/אִ֗ישׁ אֶת ־ ה/נער הַ/מְאֹ֣רָשָׂ֔ה וְ/הֶחֱזִֽיק ־ בָּ֥/הּ הָ/אִ֖ישׁ וְ/שָׁכַ֣ב עִמָּ֑/הּ וּ/מֵ֗ת הָ/אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר ־ שָׁכַ֥ב עִמָּ֖/הּ לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ ׃
rows.fluent: But if the man finds the betrothed young woman in the open country, overpowers her, and rapes her, only the man who raped her must die.

rows.hebrew: ו/ל/נער לֹא ־ תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה דָבָ֔ר אֵ֥ין ל/נער חֵ֣טְא מָ֑וֶת כִּ֡י כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ יָק֨וּם אִ֤ישׁ עַל ־ רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ וּ/רְצָח֣/וֹ נֶ֔פֶשׁ כֵּ֖ן הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה ׃

rows.fluent: Do nothing to the young woman. She has committed no offense deserving death. This case is like a man attacking his neighbor and murdering him.

rows.hebrew: כִּ֥י בַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה מְצָאָ֑/הּ צָעֲקָ֗ה ה/נער הַ/מְאֹ֣רָשָׂ֔ה וְ/אֵ֥ין מוֹשִׁ֖יעַ לָֽ/הּ ׃ ס
rows.fluent: He found her in the open country; the betrothed young woman cried out, but there was no one to rescue her.

rows.hebrew: כִּֽי ־ יִמְצָ֣א אִ֗ישׁ נער בְתוּלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא ־ אֹרָ֔שָׂה וּ/תְפָשָׂ֖/הּ וְ/שָׁכַ֣ב עִמָּ֑/הּ וְ/נִמְצָֽאוּ ׃
rows.fluent: If a man finds a young woman who is a virgin and is not betrothed, seizes her and has sex with her, and they are discovered,

rows.fluent: When you harvest your field and forget a sheaf, do not go back for it. Leave it for the resident foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, so that the LORD your God may bless all the work of your hands.

rows.hebrew: כִּ֤י תַחְבֹּט֙ זֵֽיתְ/ךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְפָאֵ֖ר אַחֲרֶ֑י/ךָ לַ/גֵּ֛ר לַ/יָּת֥וֹם וְ/לָ/אַלְמָנָ֖ה יִהְיֶֽה ׃ ס
rows.fluent: When you beat your olive trees, do not go over the branches again. Leave what remains for the resident foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.

rows.hebrew: כִּ֤י תִבְצֹר֙ כַּרְמְ/ךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְעוֹלֵ֖ל אַחֲרֶ֑י/ךָ לַ/גֵּ֛ר לַ/יָּת֥וֹם וְ/לָ/אַלְמָנָ֖ה יִהְיֶֽה ׃
rows.fluent: When you gather your grapes, do not glean the vineyard afterward. Leave what remains for the resident foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.

rows.hebrew: וְ/זָ֣כַרְתָּ֔ כִּי ־ עֶ֥בֶד הָיִ֖יתָ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל ־ כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת ־ הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּֽה ׃ ס
rows.fluent: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt. That is why I command you to do this.”

rows.fluent: Forty blows may be given, but no more. If more are added, your fellow Israelite may be degraded in your eyes by the excessive beating.

rows.fluent: Then declare before the LORD your God, ‘My father was a wandering Aramean. He went down to Egypt and lived there as a foreigner with only a few people. There he became a great nation, mighty and numerous.

rows.fluent: When you have crossed the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I command you today, and coat them with plaster.

rows.fluent: Just as the LORD rejoiced over you in doing you good and multiplying you, so the LORD will rejoice over you in making you perish and destroying you. You will be torn from the ground you are entering to possess.

rows.fluent: Yet to this day the LORD has not given you a heart to understand, eyes to see, or ears to hear.

rows.fluent: I led you through the wilderness for forty years. The clothes on you did not wear out, and the sandals on your feet did not wear out.

rows.fluent: You ate no bread and drank no wine or strong drink, so that you would know that I am the LORD your God.

rows.fluent: Someone may hear the words of this oath and curse, yet bless himself in his heart, saying, ‘I will have peace, even though I follow my stubborn heart.’ That would sweep away the watered with the thirsty.

rows.hebrew: וְ/הָיָה֩ כִֽי ־ יָבֹ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜י/ךָ כָּל ־ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה הַ/בְּרָכָה֙ וְ/הַ/קְּלָלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/הֲשֵׁבֹתָ֙ אֶל ־ לְבָבֶ֔/ךָ בְּ/כָל ־ הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִדִּיחֲ/ךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ שָֽׁמָּ/ה ׃
rows.fluent: “When all these things come upon you—the blessing and the curse I have set before you—and you take them to heart among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,

rows.hebrew: וְ/שַׁבְתָּ֞ עַד ־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֣ בְ/קֹל֔/וֹ כְּ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר ־ אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּ֑וֹם אַתָּ֣ה וּ/בָנֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כָל ־ לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ וּ/בְ/כָל ־ נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: and you return to the LORD your God and listen to him, you and your children, with all your heart and all your soul, according to everything I command you today,

rows.hebrew: וְ/שָׁ֨ב יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ אֶת ־ שְׁבוּתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/רִחֲמֶ֑/ךָ וְ/שָׁ֗ב וְ/קִבֶּצְ/ךָ֙ מִ/כָּל ־ הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֱפִֽיצְ/ךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ שָֽׁמָּ/ה ׃
rows.fluent: then the LORD your God will restore your fortunes and have compassion on you. He will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.
Even if your scattered people are at the farthest edge of the heavens, the LORD your God will gather you from there and bring you back from there.

rows.hebrew: וֶ/הֱבִֽיאֲ/ךָ֞ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ אֶל ־ הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר ־ יָרְשׁ֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ וִֽ/ירִשְׁתָּ֑/הּ וְ/הֵיטִֽבְ/ךָ֥ וְ/הִרְבְּ/ךָ֖ מֵ/אֲבֹתֶֽי/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: The LORD your God will bring you into the land your ancestors possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good and make you more numerous than your ancestors.

rows.hebrew: כִּ֚י הַ/מִּצְוָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּ֑וֹם לֹֽא ־ נִפְלֵ֥את הִוא֙ מִמְּ/ךָ֔ וְ/לֹ֥א רְחֹקָ֖ה הִֽוא ׃
rows.fluent: This commandment I am giving you today is not too difficult for you or too far away.

rows.hebrew: לֹ֥א בַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם הִ֑וא לֵ/אמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲלֶה ־ לָּ֤/נוּ הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יְמָ/ה֙ וְ/יִקָּחֶ֣/הָ לָּ֔/נוּ וְ/יַשְׁמִעֵ֥/נוּ אֹתָ֖/הּ וְ/נַעֲשֶֽׂ/נָּה ׃
rows.fluent: It is not in the heavens, so that you must ask, ‘Who will go up to the heavens for us and bring it to us, so that we can hear it and carry it out?’

rows.hebrew: וְ/לֹֽא ־ מֵ/עֵ֥בֶר לַ/יָּ֖ם הִ֑וא לֵ/אמֹ֗ר מִ֣י יַעֲבָר ־ לָ֜/נוּ אֶל ־ עֵ֤בֶר הַ/יָּם֙ וְ/יִקָּחֶ֣/הָ לָּ֔/נוּ וְ/יַשְׁמִעֵ֥/נוּ אֹתָ֖/הּ וְ/נַעֲשֶֽׂ/נָּה ׃
rows.fluent: Nor is it beyond the sea, so that you must ask, ‘Who will cross the sea for us and bring it to us, so that we can hear it and carry it out?’

rows.hebrew: כִּֽי ־ קָר֥וֹב אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ הַ/דָּבָ֖ר מְאֹ֑ד בְּ/פִ֥י/ךָ וּ/בִֽ/לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ לַ/עֲשֹׂתֽ/וֹ ׃ ס
rows.fluent: The word is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart, so that you can carry it out.

rows.hebrew: הַעִידֹ֨תִי בָ/כֶ֣ם הַ/יּוֹם֮ אֶת ־ הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם וְ/אֶת ־ הָ/אָרֶץ֒ הַ/חַיִּ֤ים וְ/הַ/מָּ֨וֶת֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ הַ/בְּרָכָ֖ה וְ/הַ/קְּלָלָ֑ה וּ/בָֽחַרְתָּ֙ בַּֽ/חַיִּ֔ים לְמַ֥עַן תִּחְיֶ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה וְ/זַרְעֶֽ/ךָ ׃
rows.fluent: I call the heavens and the earth as witnesses against you today: I have set before you life and death, blessing and curse. Choose life, so that you and your descendants may live,

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם בֶּן ־ מֵאָה֩ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם לֹא ־ אוּכַ֥ל ע֖וֹד לָ/צֵ֣את וְ/לָ/ב֑וֹא וַֽ/יהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔/י לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת ־ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֥ן הַ/זֶּֽה ׃
rows.fluent: He said to them, “I am a hundred and twenty years old today. I can no longer go out and come in, and the LORD has told me, ‘You will not cross this Jordan.’

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִֽ/יהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו לְ/עֵינֵ֣י כָל ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶ/אֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבוֹא֙ אֶת ־ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֶל ־ הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַ/אֲבֹתָ֖/ם לָ/תֵ֣ת לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/אַתָּ֖ה תַּנְחִילֶ֥/נָּה אוֹתָֽ/ם ׃
annotations: <note n="U">We agree with both BHS 1997 and BHQ on an unexpected reading. </note>
rows.fluent: Then Moses called Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you will go with this people into the land the LORD swore to their ancestors to give them, and you will cause them to inherit it.

rows.hebrew: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה כִּתְב֤וּ לָ/כֶם֙ אֶת ־ הַ/שִּׁירָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/לַמְּדָ֥/הּ אֶת ־ בְּנֵי ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׂימָ֣/הּ בְּ/פִי/הֶ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן תִּהְיֶה ־ לִּ֜/י הַ/שִּׁירָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֛את לְ/עֵ֖ד בִּ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל ׃
rows.fluent: Now write down this song, both of you. Moses, teach it to the Israelites and put it in their mouths, so that this song may be my witness against the Israelites.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יְצַ֞ו אֶת ־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן ־ נ֗וּן וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ חֲזַ֣ק וֶֽ/אֱמָץ֒ כִּ֣י אַתָּ֗ה תָּבִיא֙ אֶת ־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל ־ הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר ־ נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י אֶֽהְיֶ֥ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ ׃
rows.fluent: The LORD commissioned Joshua son of Nun: “Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land I swore to give them, and I will be with you.”

rows.hebrew: בְּ/הַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּ/הַפְרִיד֖/וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְ/מִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל ׃
rows.fluent: When the Most High gave nations their inheritance, when he divided the children of Adam, he set the boundaries of peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

rows.hebrew: יַרְכִּבֵ֨/הוּ֙ עַל ־ במותי אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יֹּאכַ֖ל תְּנוּבֹ֣ת שָׂדָ֑י וַ/יֵּנִקֵ֤/הֽוּ דְבַשׁ֙ מִ/סֶּ֔לַע וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן מֵ/חַלְמִ֥ישׁ צֽוּר ׃
annotations: <note n="y">Yathir readings in L which we have designated as Qeres when both Dothan and BHS list a Qere. </note>
rows.fluent: The LORD made Jacob ride the heights of the earth, and Jacob ate the produce of the fields. The LORD let him suck honey from rock and oil from flinty stone.
rows.prior_fluent: He made him ride the heights of the earth and eat the produce of the fields. He let him suck honey from rock and oil from flinty stone.

rows.hebrew: חֶמְאַ֨ת בָּקָ֜ר וַ/חֲלֵ֣ב צֹ֗אן עִם ־ חֵ֨לֶב כָּרִ֜ים וְ/אֵילִ֤ים בְּנֵֽי ־ בָשָׁן֙ וְ/עַתּוּדִ֔ים עִם ־ חֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת חִטָּ֑ה וְ/דַם ־ עֵנָ֖ב תִּשְׁתֶּה ־ חָֽמֶר ׃
rows.fluent: Curds from cattle and milk from flocks, with fat lambs, rams from Bashan and goats, with the richest kernels of wheat— and you drank wine, the blood of grapes.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַ/יְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶת ־ כָּל ־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/שִּׁירָֽה ־ הַ/זֹּ֖את בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם ה֖וּא וְ/הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן ־ נֽוּן ׃
rows.fluent: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the people’s hearing, he and Hoshea son of Nun.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה מִ/סִּינַ֥י בָּא֙ וְ/זָרַ֤ח מִ/שֵּׂעִיר֙ לָ֔/מוֹ הוֹפִ֨יעַ֙ מֵ/הַ֣ר פָּארָ֔ן וְ/אָתָ֖ה מֵ/רִבְבֹ֣ת קֹ֑דֶשׁ מִֽ/ימִינ֕/וֹ אשדת לָֽ/מוֹ ׃
annotations: <note type="variant"><catchWord>אשדת</catchWord><rdg type="x-qere"><w lemma="784" morph="HNcbsc" id="059bG">אֵ֥שׁ</w> <w lemma="1881" n="0.0" morph="HNcfsa" id="05UNy">דָּ֖ת</w></rdg></note>
rows.fluent: He said: “The LORD came from Sinai and dawned upon them from Seir. He shone from Mount Paran and came from myriads of holy ones; from his right hand came a fiery law for them.

rows.hebrew: יְחִ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן וְ/אַל ־ יָמֹ֑ת וִ/יהִ֥י מְתָ֖י/ו מִסְפָּֽר ׃ ס
rows.fluent: May Reuben live and not die, though his men are few.”

rows.hebrew: לְ/בִנְיָמִ֣ן אָמַ֔ר יְדִ֣יד יְהֹוָ֔ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָ/בֶ֖טַח עָלָ֑י/ו חֹפֵ֤ף עָלָי/ו֙ כָּל ־ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וּ/בֵ֥ין כְּתֵיפָ֖י/ו שָׁכֵֽן ׃ ס
rows.fluent: Of Benjamin he said: “The LORD’s beloved rests securely beside him. He shelters him all day long, and he dwells between his shoulders.”

rows.hebrew: בְּכ֨וֹר שׁוֹר֜/וֹ הָדָ֣ר ל֗/וֹ וְ/קַרְנֵ֤י רְאֵם֙ קַרְנָ֔י/ו בָּ/הֶ֗ם עַמִּ֛ים יְנַגַּ֥ח יַחְדָּ֖ו אַפְסֵי ־ אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הֵם֙ רִבְב֣וֹת אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/הֵ֖ם אַלְפֵ֥י מְנַשֶּֽׁה ׃ ס
rows.fluent: His firstborn bull has majesty; his horns are the horns of a wild ox. With them he gores peoples together to the ends of the earth. They are Ephraim’s ten thousands; they are Manasseh’s thousands.”

rows.hebrew: מְעֹנָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי קֶ֔דֶם וּ/מִ/תַּ֖חַת זְרֹעֹ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וַ/יְגָ֧רֶשׁ מִ/פָּנֶ֛י/ךָ אוֹיֵ֖ב וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַשְׁמֵֽד ׃
rows.fluent: The God of old is your dwelling place; beneath you are everlasting arms. He drove the enemy from before you and said, ‘Destroy!’

rows.hebrew: וַ/יַּ֨עַל מֹשֶׁ֜ה מֵֽ/עַרְבֹ֤ת מוֹאָב֙ אֶל ־ הַ֣ר נְב֔וֹ רֹ֚אשׁ הַ/פִּסְגָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל ־ פְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וַ/יַּרְאֵ֨/הוּ יְהוָ֧ה אֶת ־ כָּל ־ הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֶת ־ הַ/גִּלְעָ֖ד עַד ־ דָּֽן ׃
rows.fluent: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the summit of Pisgah opposite Jericho. The LORD showed him all the land: Gilead as far as Dan,

rows.hebrew: וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל ־ נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְ/אֶת ־ אֶ֥רֶץ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּ/מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל ־ אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יָּ֥ם הָ/אַחֲרֽוֹן ׃
rows.fluent: all Naphtali, the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the western sea,

rows.hebrew: וְ/אֶת ־ הַ/נֶּ֗גֶב וְֽ/אֶת ־ הַ/כִּכָּ֞ר בִּקְעַ֧ת יְרֵח֛וֹ עִ֥יר הַ/תְּמָרִ֖ים עַד ־ צֹֽעַר ׃
rows.fluent: the Negev, and the Jordan plain—the valley of Jericho, the city of palms—as far as Zoar.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗י/ו זֹ֤את הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֠שְׁבַּעְתִּי לְ/אַבְרָהָ֨ם לְ/יִצְחָ֤ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹב֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּ/ה הֶרְאִיתִ֣י/ךָ בְ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹֽר ׃
rows.fluent: The LORD said to him, “This is the land I swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have let you see it with your own eyes, but you will not cross over into it.”

rows.hebrew: וַ/יָּ֨מָת שָׁ֜ם מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶֽבֶד ־ יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מוֹאָ֖ב עַל ־ פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה ׃
rows.fluent: So Moses, the LORD’s servant, died there in the land of Moab, at the LORD’s command.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֨ר אֹת֤/וֹ בַ/גַּיְ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב מ֖וּל בֵּ֣ית פְּע֑וֹר וְ/לֹֽא ־ יָדַ֥ע אִישׁ֙ אֶת ־ קְבֻ֣רָת֔/וֹ עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה ׃
rows.fluent: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor. To this day no one knows where his grave is.

rows.hebrew: וּ/מֹשֶׁ֗ה בֶּן ־ מֵאָ֧ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּ/מֹת֑/וֹ לֹֽא ־ כָהֲתָ֥ה עֵינ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹא ־ נָ֥ס לֵחֹֽ/ה ׃
rows.fluent: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died. His eyes had not grown dim, and his vigor had not left him.

rows.hebrew: וַ/יִּבְכּוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת ־ מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֥ת מוֹאָ֖ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים י֑וֹם וַֽ/יִּתְּמ֔וּ יְמֵ֥י בְכִ֖י אֵ֥בֶל מֹשֶֽׁה ׃
rows.fluent: The Israelites wept for Moses on the plains of Moab for thirty days. Then the days of weeping and mourning for Moses came to an end.

rows.hebrew: וִֽ/יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן ־ נ֗וּן מָלֵא֙ ר֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֔ה כִּֽי ־ סָמַ֥ךְ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת ־ יָדָ֖י/ו עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֨וּ אֵלָ֤י/ו בְּנֵֽי ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת ־ מֹשֶֽׁה ׃
rows.fluent: Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom, because Moses had laid his hands on him. The Israelites listened to him and did as the LORD had commanded Moses.

rows.hebrew: וְ/לֹֽא ־ קָ֨ם נָבִ֥יא ע֛וֹד בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּ/מֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְדָע֣/וֹ יְהוָ֔ה פָּנִ֖ים אֶל ־ פָּנִֽים ׃
rows.fluent: Since then, no prophet has arisen in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face.
rows.prior_fluent: Never again has a prophet like Moses arisen in Israel, whom the LORD knew face to face,

rows.hebrew: לְ/כָל ־ הָ֨/אֹת֜וֹת וְ/הַ/מּוֹפְתִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר שְׁלָח/וֹ֙ יְהוָ֔ה לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְ/פַרְעֹ֥ה וּ/לְ/כָל ־ עֲבָדָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/כָל ־ אַרְצֽ/וֹ ׃
rows.fluent: No prophet has matched him in all the signs and wonders the LORD sent him to perform in the land of Egypt against Pharaoh, all his servants, and all his land,
rows.prior_fluent: with all the signs and wonders the LORD sent him to perform in the land of Egypt against Pharaoh, all his servants, and all his land,

rows.hebrew: וּ/לְ/כֹל֙ הַ/יָּ֣ד הַ/חֲזָקָ֔ה וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל הַ/מּוֹרָ֣א הַ/גָּד֑וֹל אֲשֶׁר֙ עָשָׂ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל ־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל ׃
rows.fluent: or in the mighty hand and all the great terror Moses displayed before the eyes of all Israel.
rows.prior_fluent: and with all the mighty hand and all the great terror Moses displayed before the eyes of all Israel.
